acceptance.harness: Complete accounting for every pinned candidate and directory; successful cases have exact fresh replay and response prefix equality; independent metric recomputation and tamper rejection. Cases may fail without failing inventory completeness.
acceptance.model: No model qualification or accuracy success flag in this iteration. No consumer API or learner changes.
acceptance.next: Use observed setup gaps to freeze a subsequent recording/accuracy protocol with explicit valid operating regimes and whole-parent/system holdouts; preserve this audit rather than selecting an attractive subset after fitting.

initialization.method: Fresh FGFDMExec per parent, exact replay, and response branch. Disable input and output before load and again after load. Explicit aircraft directory/model stem with addModelToPath=False supports variants. Load selected IC with useAircraftPath=False; set_dt(1/120), then run_ic. No scripts, external pilot, engine startup beyond running tags already in selected IC, or turbulence changes.
initialization.powered_scope: Shipped IC engine-running tags can invoke engine steady-state initialization. Others may be unpowered. Report engine count, initial running properties when available, engine/actuator diagnostics, ground clearance and initial motion. Results only concern initialized configuration.
initialization.randomness: Set JSBSIM_DISPERSE=0 before constructing every instance and simulation/randomseed=0 before load_model. No additional turbulence/atmosphere seed override.
initialization.rule: Prefer a trim-free reset00.xml in the configuration directory; otherwise lexicographically first trim-free initialize-root XML. Record all IC candidates. Load model even if IC missing; missing IC is a setup outcome. Preserve source IC semantics; do not invent initial speeds/altitudes or call aircraft trim.

inventory_policy: Every recursively discovered XML root whose lowercase tag is fdm_config, including uppercase legacy/template candidates. All61 directories retained including documentation-only LM. No replacement or outcome-driven configuration/IC fixes.
named_gap: Reproducible simulator onboarding before controller-independent JSBSim model qualification
outputs: initial diagnostics and active/weak command counts
machine-readable report, sealed file hashes, replay/tamper audit

recording.case_timeout_scope: 120s for the entire candidate subprocess including load,parent,replay,branch0 and all signed branches. Timeout is an execution outcome, never claimed to establish deterministic physics, and all missing response slots remain unavailable. A later audit records fresh timeout/completion separately and cannot promote an originally timed-out case.
recording.commands: aileron, elevator, rudder normalized FCS properties plus one throttle-cmd-norm per engine, index0 unindexed then [i]. Applied commands are values written at FCS/engine command boundary, not measured surface positions. FCS/actuator dynamics are part of the plant.
recording.conversion: feet to meters exactly0.3048; get_Tl2b transpose flattened row-major. Observations atx0 and after each full held-command interval.
recording.failure: False load/IC/run, exception, nonfinite observation, absent required property, invalid command baseline, rotation maxabs(R.T@R-I)>1e-8 or abs(detR-1)>1e-8. Save partial data and failure stage; never discard/replace case. Finite states alone establish no physical flight validity.
recording.property_validation: Require observation and command paths to exist in get_property_catalog before reading/writing; do not mistake dynamic property creation for an exposed input. Surface names are fcs/aileron-cmd-norm,fcs/elevator-cmd-norm,fcs/rudder-cmd-norm; throttle names fcs/throttle-cmd-norm forindex0, fcs/throttle-cmd-norm[i] fori>0.
recording.tape: Read initial command values after run_ic, reject nonfinite or out-of-bounds. Every5 recorded steps draw independent uniform[-1,1] offsets of0.05 times full channel range around initial command; clip to declared bounds. Reassert the identical intended row before EACH of6 native substeps. Save intended tape[T,M] and immediate/end-native-step readbacks[T,6,M]; report overwrites without replacing command histories.

replay.activity: A channel is detectably active if any signed branch exceeds the threshold for any corresponding observation across5steps. Report all magnitudes and inactive/weak channels. Detectability is descriptive and not successful response learning. Activity is null/unavailable unless the factual parent and both signed branches for that command complete and replay their prefixes. Failed/missing branches never count inactive.
replay.audit: Recreate every model initialization and parent/branch trajectory from pinned files; recompute activity/summary. Verify runtime/source/data hashes. Reject modified protocol, model assets, saved trajectory, command, branch mapping, and summary; include coherently rehashed evidence alterations.
replay.branches: For each command independently,+/- probes move that command in the saved intended/written factual future tape10percent toward its upper/lower bound at each of5steps. Each branch uses a fresh instance and replays all20 prior intervals. Require bitwise identical prefix. Branch0 is factual continuation from another fresh instance and must match original. Save branch histories, commands, means and signed deltas; no cloning or learner.
replay.parent: Fresh simulator, same IC and complete command tape. Require bitwise identical all observed states and command readbacks. Mismatch is replay_failure, not silently relaxed.

scope: No fitting, model scoring, controller trial or model promotion. Complete released configuration inventory and short initialized transient/command-response/replay audit. Numerical completeness is not a valid flight regime or operational envelope.
